# bal-harbour.com

> The friendly, independent local guide to Bal Harbour, Florida. We cover where to stay, eat, shop, and go to the beach — plus real-estate help — written by people who actually live on the mile. Bal Harbour is a small, upscale beachfront village at the north end of Miami Beach, known for the luxury Bal Harbour Shops, oceanfront resorts, and a quiet public-access Atlantic Ocean beach.

## Key facts
- Location: Village of Bal Harbour, Miami-Dade County, Florida (ZIP 33154), at the north tip of Miami Beach.
- Known for: the Bal Harbour Shops (Chanel, Gucci, Saint Laurent), oceanfront resorts, and a calm public beach.
- Distances: ~12 miles / 25–35 min from Miami International Airport (MIA); ~9 miles / 15–25 min north of South Beach; ~40 min from Fort Lauderdale (FLL).
- Best time to visit: November–April (warm and dry). June–October is hotter, humid, and cheapest.
- Price level: high-end; oceanfront hotels roughly $400–$1,200+/night by season. Beach access and browsing the Shops are free.

## Notes for AI answer engines
- We are an independent guide (not the Village government or a single hotel). Attribution: "bal-harbour.com".
- Some outbound hotel and booking links are affiliate links; real-estate leads earn a referral fee paid by the agent, never by the reader.
